subject.title: feat(gateway): handle Feishu VC meeting invites

question: Should `vc.bot.meeting_invited_v1` subscription plus an authorized user's explicit meeting invitation be sufficient consent for OpenClaw to create an agent turn and join automatically, without a separate Feishu configuration switch?
rationale: The code can support either policy, but choosing whether a platform subscription and invite authorize an externally visible automatic action is a product and operator-consent decision rather than a correctness question.

options.title: Use subscription and invite as consent
options.body: Keep the current no-config design because the administrator explicitly subscribes to the event and an authorized user explicitly invites the bot, avoiding another permanent configuration surface.

options.title: Require a default-off switch
options.body: Add a Feishu setting that must be enabled before invite events can create turns, preserving inert upgrade behavior for installations that already subscribe to the event.

options.title: Pause automatic join
options.body: Keep the linked issue open but defer bundled automatic meeting joins if maintainers do not want the consent or support burden in the Feishu plugin.

recommendation.title: Use subscription and invite as consent
recommendation.body: Keep the current no-config design because the administrator explicitly subscribes to the event and an authorized user explicitly invites the bot, avoiding another permanent configuration surface.
